title: Polymarket Scraper Input
description: Pull Polymarket prediction markets at scale. Filter by search query, category, tag, or fetch direct slugs / condition IDs. Optionally enrich each row with order book depth, recent trades, and price history. One row per market.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keyword search across market questions and descriptions. Each query runs separately and results merge.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Pick any combination: keywords, categories, tags, slugs, or condition IDs.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Top level Polymarket categories. Resolves to internal tag IDs.

tagIds.title: Tag IDs
tagIds.description: Direct numeric tag IDs from Polymarket (advanced). Useful when a category is not in the dropdown.

marketSlugs.title: Market slugs
marketSlugs.description: Direct market slugs to scrape, e.g. "will-trump-win-2024". Found in the Polymarket URL after /event/.

conditionIds.title: Condition IDs
conditionIds.description: Direct hex condition IDs (0x...). Bypasses search and pulls the exact market.

status.title: Market status
status.description: Active = currently trading. Closed = no longer accepting orders. Resolved = outcome decided.

minVolume24h.title: Minimum 24h volume (USD)
minVolume24h.description: Drop markets below this 24h trading volume.

minTotalVolume.title: Minimum total volume (USD)
minTotalVolume.description: Drop markets below this lifetime volume.

minLiquidity.title: Minimum liquidity (USD)
minLiquidity.description: Drop markets below this on book liquidity. Useful for filtering thin markets.

includeOrderbook.title: Include order book
includeOrderbook.description: Pull the live CLOB order book per outcome (top bids and asks with size). Adds 1 request per outcome.
includeOrderbook.sectionDescription: Each enrichment adds API calls. Off by default to keep runs cheap.

orderbookDepth.title: Order book depth
orderbookDepth.description: Max number of bid + ask levels to keep per outcome.

includeRecentTrades.title: Include recent trades
includeRecentTrades.description: Pull the most recent trades for each market from the public data API. Adds 1 request per market.

recentTradesLimit.title: Recent trades per market
recentTradesLimit.description: Max number of recent trades to attach per market.

includePriceHistory.title: Include price history
includePriceHistory.description: Pull the YES outcome price history time series for each market. Adds 1 request per market.

priceHistoryInterval.title: Price history interval
priceHistoryInterval.description: Time window for price history. Polymarket samples within the window.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Hard cap per (search query, category, tag) combination. Stops paging once reached.

maxItemsTotal.title: Total maximum items
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on rows pushed per run across all sources. 0 means unlimited.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip condition IDs already pushed in previous runs. Persisted in a key value store. Turn off to refresh.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of enrichment requests fetched in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Polymarket public APIs work fine on datacenter or unproxied; residential is only needed if you hit aggressive rate limits.
